s: May 18, 2018 - Keeping it in a closet felt wrong and I wasn’t about to display it in my curio cabinet. This skull needed a new home. But figuring out how to make that happen was trickier than I thought. My research took me down a rabbit hole. Surprisingly, there’s no federal law against owning, buying or selling human skulls (except Native American ones), although there’s a patchwork of vague and often unenforced state regulations.
